title: Kevin Roose：国会连AI工具都用不明白，还怎么监管？
speaker: Kevin Roose

segments.en: I mean the government can do it. They just may not because they are stuck in SACIS they have
segments.zh: 政府可以做，只是可能不会，因为他们陷在旧模式里，他们

segments.en: Failed to regulate every important new technology on a relevant time scale. I mean think about it
segments.zh: 没能在相关时间尺度上监管每一项重要的新技术。想想看

segments.en: Social media is now 20 years old 25 years old and we still don't have there's it's getting regulated through the courts
segments.zh: 社交媒体已经20年、25年了，我们仍然没有，它正通过法院被监管

segments.en: It's getting regulated through the courts, but it's but Congress has not passed a single law so
segments.zh: 它正通过法院被监管，但国会没有通过一项法律，所以

segments.en: I think in the absence of like strong federal regulation. We'll see some state-level regulation
segments.zh: 我认为在缺乏强有力的联邦监管的情况下，我们会看到一些州级监管

segments.en: We might see some self-regulation among the labs
segments.zh: 我们可能会看到实验室之间的一些自我监管

segments.en: But I'm skeptical that we're going to get some federal regulation and in part
segments.zh: 但我怀疑我们能否得到联邦监管，部分

segments.en: I think that's because the members of Congress do not understand this technology
segments.zh: 我认为那是因为国会议员不了解这项技术

segments.en: I was just interviewing a member of Congress at a conference the other day and I learned
segments.zh: 前几天我在一个会议上采访一位国会议员，我了解到

segments.en: That in the US House of Representatives the only approved AI tool for member and staff use is Microsoft copilot
segments.zh: 在美国众议院，议员和工作人员唯一被批准使用的AI工具是Microsoft Copilot

segments.en: I was going to guess clippy
And look nothing against Microsoft. I'm sure it's a fine product
segments.zh: 我对微软没意见。我相信这是个好产品

segments.en: But like if you if that is all you're allowed to use
segments.zh: 但如果你只被允许用那个

segments.en: You're not actually aware of what the technology can do at the frontier
segments.zh: 你实际上不知道这项技术在前沿能做什么

segments.en: You need to be using the frontier models to understand what they're capable of
segments.zh: 你需要使用前沿模型来理解它们的能力
